source: Source: Rockstar North (Rob Nelson) via IGN, Edge, Eurogamer previews
notes: Autopilot 17.11. for Thu 19.11. 18:00 Berlin (= 12:00 ET), GTA 6 TIP #1. Built pre-launch from Rockstar statements in previews (no post-unlock guides exist yet) -> the 18.11. evening launch check may swap in post-unlock tips. Facts: (1) police description = outfit, vehicle, seen as a couple; change car/outfit or split up (Eurogamer 28.08. + IGN preview/Nelson interview; GameSpot: crimes shown as icons under the stars). (2) some parked cars locked until you get tools later in the story, you can always carjack a driver (Nelson to IGN 27.08.; Guardian via Vice 14.11.; GameSpot). (3) WAINK phone app scans a parked car: locked, alarm, tracker (Nelson to IGN 27.08.; Edge issue 430 via GTA Boom 30.10.). (4) cars + motorbikes have a fuel gauge, refuel at gas stations, EVs recharge (Edge via GTA Boom; GTABase previews roundup; GameSpot 23.10.). (5) 'All your weapons that you've purchased will always be available in the back of your personal vehicle' (Nelson to IGN 07.10.) + Scooter Bros app delivers your car (Edge via GTA Boom; GTABase; Vice). Carry-limit numbers deliberately NOT used (sources disagree). No spoilers, no glitches. Dup check vs all 56 posts since 10.10.: no GTA mechanics/tips post before; out-now 19.11. 00:00 = GTA+/map/DualSense/album/server (no overlap). | Verifier 17.11.: FAIL->fixed: "Every vehicle" -> "Cars and motorbikes" (GTABase); Scooter Bros fee removed (only Edge). tips.title: COPS KNOW YOUR LOOK
tips.body: Police track your outfit, your car and if you were seen as a couple. Swap cars, change clothes or split up to lose them.

tips.title: SOME CARS ARE LOCKED
tips.body: Some parked cars need tools you unlock later in the story. Need a ride now? You can always carjack a driver.

tips.title: SCAN WITH WAINK
tips.body: Point WAINK at a parked car: it shows if it's locked, has an alarm or a tracker that can lead the cops to you.

tips.title: WATCH YOUR FUEL
tips.body: Cars and motorbikes have a fuel gauge. Refill at gas stations, EVs recharge. Check it before a getaway.

tips.title: GUNS IN THE TRUNK
tips.body: Weapons you buy are always in your personal vehicle. Car too far away? Scooter Bros delivers it to you.
